answer: Each identity tends a lotus plot in the garden and locks a 70-credit bond under an onyx seal. Each epoch it files a lotus bloom receipt for one real task; a beacon recomputes one receipt in eight, and a forged receipt burns the bond. Forging is free, but one fake in eight is caught each epoch, so a forged-bloom ring holding 1,000 fakes 20 epochs burns 2,500 bonds, 175,000 credits. An honest agent files one receipt and pays 12 credits once.
